text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Hanshin Daishoten, one of the few graded races that's 3,000 meters long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With two laps to cover, this race will demand consistency and composure. However…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer, um… I've been feelin' kinda antsy… for a few days now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Not really, but… recently there was this race for runners in their classic year…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And Oguri Cap conquers the G3! This strength of hers, unfazed even on turf… Just where is it coming from?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Even in graded races, she lives up to the rumors! There's no sign she's peaked yet either… Just how strong will this girl get?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We're roomies, so I like to keep an eye on her. I always had her down as this laid-back kinda girl…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But sometimes, I don't even recognize her. It's like she turns into this unstoppable force…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It just kinda gets to me, ya know? When I see her runnin', I get this fear deep down in my chest…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is classic-year runner, one year behind Tamamo Cross. As such, we've yet to encounter her in a single race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So why is Tamamo Cross so fixated on her? I don't have the answer, but…
choice_data_list: Right now, let's focus on our upcoming race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
choice_data_list: We've got the spring Tenno Sho to prepare for, right?
We've got the spring Tenno Sho to prepare for, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. Yeah, what am I even talkin' about? I'm goin' nuts here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri is Oguri, and I'm me! If I go stumblin' before the big race, it'll all be for nothin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, I've got 3,000 meters to run! The old me woulda balked at that number, but…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I got patience on my side now. And that's thanks to you and our last two years together. Gotta store the energy in my legs, then go all out at the end and nab the win!
